latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Remind Me skill for creating, listing, and canceling reminders and cron jobs scoped to the current chat/channel.

- Handles "remind me", "set an alarm", "schedule a cron", "alert me", "cancel reminder", and "list my reminders" commands.
- Auto-detects channel and chat ID from session context (never asks user for these).
- Requires clear specification of WHAT (reminder), WHEN (schedule), and WHERE (delivery target) before creating any job, with interactive clarification if any are missing or ambiguous.
- Supports one-time (`at:`), recurring (`every:`), and cron-based (`cron:`) reminders; asks user for confirmation before executing.
- Provides commands and formatting for creating, listing, and canceling reminders or cron jobs, always confirming intent with the user.
